project.name: MAX MTF
project.purpose: Quantitative trading research and governed deployment system for strategy optimization, multi-timeframe data authority, model research, Challenger/Champion lifecycle, ONNX deployment, and MT5 execution.
expected_outcomes: Produce causally valid research evidence and qualified Strategy/Model Challengers
Keep promotion authority explicit and auditable
Preserve exact source, data, model, and runtime lineage across research and deployment
Fail closed when required scientific or external runtime evidence is missing
Keep the public Git repository source-only; Owner runtime evidence and private market/runtime artifacts stay outside public Git history

entry_points.name: GitHub Windows Source CI
entry_points.purpose: Run public-source safety, MTF source contracts, and governance validation on GitHub-hosted Windows runners

entry_points.name: Control Room
entry_points.purpose: Bootstrap Python 3.12 environment and start Streamlit operator UI

entry_points.name: Local cumulative acceptance
entry_points.purpose: Run the canonical ordered 75-gate local acceptance suite

entry_points.name: MTF-1 final closure
entry_points.purpose: Bind fresh local acceptance, Owner MT5 proof, MetaEditor proof and final read-only verification

entry_points.name: MTF-1 Owner runtime
entry_points.purpose: Collect and verify native Owner MT5 M5/M15/H1/H4 evidence

entry_points.name: Strategy Optimizer worker
entry_points.purpose: Execute bounded MT5 strategy optimization rounds and produce Strategy Challengers

entry_points.name: AUTO Factory
entry_points.purpose: Route production AUTO research to LangGraph and deterministic Factory stages

entry_points.name: Scientist Chat
entry_points.purpose: Provide read-only evidence-grounded research discussion and bounded analysis

constraints: maxqstudio/max-mtf main is public source authority; work branches are candidates until accepted and merged.
Public Git history is source-only: Owner runtime evidence, broker provenance, market data, compiled artifacts, model binaries, local calibration and secrets are forbidden.
GitHub Actions is development/source-test authority between Owner acceptance checkpoints; environment-dependent MT5/MetaEditor runtime acceptance is Owner-only at phase end.
No automatic Strategy or Model Champion replacement.
Scientist is advisory and cannot override deterministic admission, PASS/FAIL, protected holdouts, or promotion.
Editable configuration does not rewrite frozen execution evidence.
MTF-1 closure prerequisite for later phases is historical external evidence; every later implementation, research, runtime and promotion claim requires phase-specific proof.
Generated canonical documentation under docs/ is a deterministic projection of .workflow specs plus observed source facts.
